proposed.text: What does the acronym SPPCC stand for under the UAP SPP framework?

options.text: Statement of Probable Project Construction Cost
Standards of Professional Practice Coordinating Committee
Standards of Professional Practice Compliance Council
Standards of Professional Practice Certification Commission

proposed.rationale: Per SPP Document 202, SPPCC means Statement of Probable Project Construction Cost. The Architect prepares or updates the SPPCC during the design phases, but the SPP warns that such estimates have only a certain degree of accuracy because the Architect does not control labor, materials, and competitive bidding factors; the SPPCC is an estimate, not a guaranteed construction cost. 'Standards of Professional Practice Coordinating Committee' is a fabricated backronym and is an exam trap. Source: PRBoA SPP 202 (https://www.architectureboard.com.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/1.4-2010-SPP-for-PH-Architects.pdf).
proposed.explanation: SPPCC = Statement of Probable Project Construction Cost per SPP 202, not a 'Coordinating Committee' backronym.
